notes.hook: The concept of a star choking on its own soot is an excellent, attention-grabbing hook.
notes.clarity: The explanation of the reverse nova mechanism is simple and easy to follow on one listen.
notes.payoff: The resolution explaining how soot forms and clears provides a very satisfying payoff.
notes.visuals: Several frames depict unrelated astronomical objects instead of R Coronae Borealis.
notes.loop: The seamless transition from the final line to the first creates an effective replay loop.

frames.problem: Shows the 2019 dimming of Betelgeuse instead of the subject star R Coronae Borealis.
Uses a JWST image of the Carina Nebula, which is unrelated to this star.
Shows Barnard 68, a completely different dark nebula, rather than R Coronae Borealis.

rounds.better_than_last: It introduces a more mysterious and lesser-known stellar phenomenon compared to the galactic collision in episode 71.
